globalDbStorage.overview: Holistic Supabase schema for Phase 1, versioned via CLI migrations in Git. Core tables: 'jobs' as hub (links all phases). RLS for user/admin access (e.g., row.owner_id = auth.uid()). Indexing on frequent queries (e.g., jobs.scope_summary text search, products.voc_level). JSONB for flexible fields (e.g., risks as array). Storage bucket 'enki-storage' with job_id paths for PDFs (metadata JSON linking to DB, e.g., {bidId: '123', type: 'specs'}). No deletes—use soft deletes (deleted_at timestamp). Scale for 100+ jobs: Partition 'submittals' by job_id if needed.

tables.name: jobs
tables.relations: Central hub; has_many for all phase-specific tables.

tables.name: products
tables.relations: Queried in 1C/1H; many_to_many jobs via product_matches.

tables.name: rfis
tables.relations: Logged in 1D; shared blueprint-wide via button.

tables.name: schedules
tables.relations: Tracked in 1F; links to products for lead times.

tables.name: cos
tables.relations: Tracked in 1G; links to schedules for delay impacts.

storage.structure: User/job-specific paths (e.g., user_id/job_id/file_type/safe_name); metadata JSON (e.g., {phase: '1A', type: 'specs', risks: jsonb}). Public URLs for reviews/emails; RLS for access.

globalDbStorage.migrations: Declarative SQL files in Git; Supabase CLI for push/pull. Versioned for additions (e.g., add columns nullable). Test in dev env.
